decisions.reason: The source changes the downstream HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list flow, not the LinkedIn-to-HubSpot ingestion path.
This Requirement already requires exporting follow-up lists to MeetAlfred; the general list-push instruction does not change its current state.
HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list synchronization does not change Apollo enrichment data, mode, provider, or target.
The source addresses exporting HubSpot lists, not how lead lists are created or categorized within HubSpot.
The list synchronization decision does not resolve or alter how existing CRM records are identified.
The source does not change which LinkedIn or Sales Navigator URLs are stored in CRM records.
The email integration clause is already represented by this candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, and the list-sync modification adds no missing email-integration state.
Integrating email and enabling list synchronization does not necessarily change which communication-history channels are visible in HubSpot lead records.
The source requests an operational reverse list flow but does not modify the separate task-local deliverable mapping MeetAlfred-to-HubSpot data flow.
The integration decision does not alter the isolated-account, existing-campaign, or existing-lead testing safeguards.
The source establishes list transfer to MeetAlfred but does not change HubSpot lead-nurturing workflow behavior.
The source does not alter MeetAlfred account setup or the selected Pro subscription plan.
